title: JELL-O™ X TOWER 28 Lil' Pudding Mini Lip Softie Gift Set

descriptionHtml:
✓ Vegan✓ Hydrating✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Without Parabens✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Good for: Dryness

What it is: A limited-edition JELL-O® x Tower 28 gift set featuring four mini LipSoftie Tinted Lip Treatments in four iconic creamy flavors, exclusive to this set and inspired by your fave puddings.
Highlighted Ingredients:
- Shea Butter: Boosts lip hydration and soothes skin.

- Jojoba Oil: Locks in moisture to keep lips soft and supple.

- Lysine: Prevents dryness and smooths and softens lips.
